h1: AI Integration Services: Connect AI to Your Systems
lead: Crenosoft connects AI models such as GPT, Claude and Gemini to the systems your business already runs: CRMs, ERPs, accounting software, document stores and internal databases. AI then works with your real data, inside the tools your staff already use.
facts: Integrations with CRMs, ERPs and document stores
answer: AI integration services connect artificial intelligence models to a business’s existing software and data, so AI can read records, write updates and work inside current workflows. Typical integrations add AI summaries, drafting, classification or question answering to CRMs, ERPs, helpdesks, intranets and internal apps.
body:
Why integration matters more than the model

Out of the box, ChatGPT or Claude knows nothing about your customers, products or policies. Staff copy information in, copy answers out, and the result never reaches the system of record. Integration closes that gap. When AI can securely read the right records and write back to the right place, it stops being a separate chat window and becomes part of how work gets done.

Common AI integrations

Your own app or databaseCustom AI features through APIsAI tailored to your product

How we integrate AI securely

  1. Least-privilege access. The integration only reaches the data and actions the use case needs.
  2. Permission-aware retrieval. When AI searches your documents, it respects the same access rights as the user asking.
  3. Data minimisation. Only necessary fields are sent to the model; sensitive fields can be masked.
  4. Provider settings. We use business and API terms where data isn’t used to train public models, where the provider offers that option.
  5. Logging and audit. Requests, responses and actions are logged for review.
  6. Human approval for writes or messages above a set risk level.

Our approach follows the Privacy Act 1988 and the OAIC’s guidance on commercially available AI products.

Choosing models for each task

Different tasks suit different models. Summarising long documents, extracting fields from invoices and answering customer questions each have different accuracy, speed and cost needs. We test candidate models from OpenAI, Anthropic and Google against your real examples, following their documentation such as OpenAI’s platform docs and Anthropic’s Claude docs, and pick the best fit per step. Integrations are built so models can be swapped as better options appear, without rebuilding everything.

Integration approaches

  • Native AI features already in your software, configured properly. Often the quickest win.
  • Workflow platforms such as n8n or Make, which add AI steps between systems. See AI workflow automation.
  • Custom API integration for deeper, faster or more secure connections, built and hosted by us.
  • Knowledge-base assistants that answer from your documents. See LLM and RAG development.

Cost and performance controls

AI usage costs scale with volume, so we design for efficiency from the start: caching repeated requests, routing simple tasks to cheaper models, trimming prompts and setting usage limits. You receive a monthly report on usage, cost and accuracy.

How an AI integration project runs

  1. Free AI audit to map your systems and the integration with the best payback.
  2. Technical discovery of APIs, data structures, permissions and security requirements.
  3. Prototype on a copy of real data, measured against agreed examples.
  4. Build, test and launch, usually three to eight weeks depending on systems.
  5. Monitoring and support with monthly reporting.

Signs you need AI integration

  • Staff copy and paste between ChatGPT and your business systems every day
  • You pay for AI features in several tools but none of them share information
  • Answers to common questions are buried across SharePoint, email and your CRM
  • Managers want AI summaries but the data lives in systems the AI can’t reach

When these patterns appear, an integration usually saves more time than adding another AI tool. It also reduces risk, because information flows through approved, logged connections instead of individual staff accounts. A short technical discovery tells you which integration will deliver the most value first, and what it would take to build.

Most integrations start with one system and one use case, such as AI call summaries in your CRM, then expand once the first one is proven and your team trusts the results.

Where an off-the-shelf connector already exists and meets your security needs, we use it, and save custom code for the parts where it genuinely adds value.
faqs: Can you integrate ChatGPT with our CRM?

Yes. We connect models such as GPT, Claude and Gemini to CRMs including HubSpot, Zoho and Salesforce, for call summaries, email drafts, lead scoring and next-step suggestions written back into the record.
Is our data safe when integrated with AI?

We use least-privilege access, send only the fields each task needs, use provider settings that keep data out of public model training where available, and log every request. Hosting is in Australian regions where the service allows.
Do we need custom code for AI integration?
Not always. Some integrations use native AI features or workflow tools like n8n and Make. Custom API work suits deeper, higher-volume or more secure use cases.
Can we switch AI providers later?
Yes. We design integrations so the model can be swapped with minimal changes, which lets you adopt better or cheaper models as they appear.
